# Research Paper (ICSE SEET 2027)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Page limit** | Max **10 pages**, plus up to **2 pages of references** (strict; violations are desk-rejected) |
| **Definition** | Must address a topic related to software engineering and education using appropriate research techniques and proper scholarly writing. **Negative and mixed findings are acceptable.** |
| **Evaluation criteria** | Relevance, Significance, Soundness, Verifiability, Presentation (see [criterion definitions](../../evaluation-criteria)) |
